name: Manager Kanau
source: Kanau is the boss of Taihei, Takeshi and Alex. She has known Taihei and Takeshi since high school ten years ago. She is very fond of Taihei, and tries to flirt with him, but gets annoyed by Takeshi, whom she physically scolds.
